Package org.cibseven.connect.ai.agent.agentic

Class AgenticOutcome

java.lang.Object
org.cibseven.connect.ai.agent.agentic.AgenticOutcome
public final class AgenticOutcome extends Object
How a turn ended, for the process to branch on (CIB7-2151).

Every turn that ends writes one of these next to its answer: under OUTCOME in the response the output parameters read, so ${outcome} maps it, and to DEFAULT_VARIABLE when the connector has no output parameters. The answer stays the text for people; this is what a gateway after the scope reads.

A limit is no failure by default: the scope ends as after any turn, once nothing runs, and the process goes on. With ON_LIMIT_PROPERTY set to ON_LIMIT_ERROR the scope ends with a BPMN error instead, its code the outcome, which a boundary event on the scope catches.
